meta.what: Aggregate FPI/FII stake per listed company, from the quarterly shareholding filing
meta.source: Screener-cached shareholding tables (data/screener/*.json); market cap from legacy_mcap_daily.csv
meta.signal: d_fii_pp = quarter-on-quarter change in FII % of equity, in PERCENTAGE POINTS. Price-neutral by construction (a % of the company cannot be moved by price alone), so it needs no de-pricing — the foreign analogue of weight-space net-active.
meta.value_identity: H = f*M ; dH = f_prev*dM (value effect) + M_now*df (flow effect); residual 1.02e-10 cr
caveats: QUARTERLY and LAGGED — filings land ~3-6 weeks after quarter end; never read as timely.
SHORT HISTORY — 44 quarters only. Descriptive positioning context, NOT a validated signal; it would likely fail a strict signal_navtest bar.
SHARE ISSUANCE moves FII% mechanically: a QIP/rights/ESOP that FPIs skip dilutes their stake without any selling, and a buyback lifts it. mcap_jump marks the suspect quarters.
'FIIs' can include strategic/FDI-type foreign holders, not only portfolio money.
NOT attributable to any named manager — India publishes no 13F. Names only appear above 1% (module B1) and above 5% (SAST, already in events.py).
Rupee views cover only the ~800 names with market-cap history; the % panel is wider.
